quantra_Period.description:
Canonical period type used across APIs. Both fields are presence-required:
a bare `n` would silently default to 0 and an omitted `unit` would silently
mean Months, so a forgotten value is a 400 naming the field rather than a
silent (0 Months) tenor.

quantra_FlowInterest.description: Interest cash flow with fixing and accrual metadata.

quantra_FlowsWrapper.description: Wrapper for a single flow in a collection.

quantra_QuoteMatrix2D.description: 2D quote matrix (n_rows x n_cols). Interpretation depends on caller.

quote_ids.description: Optional, length = values. Empty => inline values.

quantra_QuoteTensor3D.description: 3D quote tensor (n_1 x n_2 x n_3). Interpretation depends on caller.

quote_ids.description: Optional, length = values. Empty => inline values.

quantra_IrVolBaseSpec.description: IR volatility base (Normal, Lognormal, ShiftedLognormal). Supports caps/floors and swaptions.

volatility_type.description:
Quotation convention of the supplied vols. Presence-required: an omitted
type is a 400, never the alphabetical-0 default (Normal), which would
price a lognormal-quoted surface as normal vols.

quantra_BlackVolBaseSpec.description: Equity/FX volatility base (always lognormal, no displacement).

quantra_SwaptionVolAtmMatrixSpec.description: ATM matrix swaption volatility (expiry x tenor).

quantra_SwaptionVolSmileCubeSpec.description: Smile cube swaption volatility (expiry x tenor x strike).

allow_external_atm.description: Require explicit opt-in when client provides atm_forwards.

atm_forwards.description: Optional for Absolute, required for SpreadFromATM.

quantra_SwaptionSabrCalibrateSpec.description:
SABR calibrate swaption volatility.

Strike axis interpretation: `strikes` are spreads from the per-node ATM
forward (rate units, e.g. -0.02 = -200bp). The same spread vector applies
at every (expiry, tenor) node, matching QuantLib's XabrSwaptionVolatilityCube
API. 0.0 spread (true ATM) is not required to be in the grid — per-node ATM
vols are interpolated from the user grid at spread=0.

`vols` is row-major nExp*nTen*nStrikes; values are absolute market vols.

`weights` is rejected in v1 — set `vega_weighted_smile_fit=true` for
vega-weighted fitting instead. Per-strike non-uniform weights are not
exposed by QuantLib 1.41's calibrator.

weights.description: Reserved. Must be empty/absent in v1; otherwise parse-time rejection.

vega_weighted_smile_fit.description:
When true, the SABR calibrator weights residuals by Black vega. This is
the standard "vega-weighted smile fit" QL flag (cube-level, not per
strike).

swap_index_id.description: Required convention anchor for all swaption vol surfaces.

strikes.description: Surface strike axis (required only for shape=SmileCube3D).

term_vols.description: Term vols as QuoteMatrix2D with dims (n_expiries x 1), row-major.

surface_vols.description: Surface vols as QuoteMatrix2D with dims (n_expiries x n_strikes), row-major by expiry then strike.

surface_prices.description:
Surface prices as QuoteMatrix2D with dims (n_price_expiries x n_price_strikes), row-major by expiry then strike.
Used only when base.shape=SurfaceFromPrices.

price_expiries.description: Absolute expiry dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Used only when base.shape=SurfaceFromPrices.

price_strikes.description: Surface strike axis for prices matrix. Used only when base.shape=SurfaceFromPrices.

price_option_type.description: Option type used for implied-vol inversion from prices. Used only when base.shape=SurfaceFromPrices.

spot.description: Spot level for implied-vol inversion. Optional if spot_quote_id is provided.

discount_curve_id.description: Discount curve id in pricing.curves used for implied-vol inversion.

use_flat_discount_rate.description: If true and discount_curve_id is empty, use flat_discount_rate.

flat_discount_rate.description: Continuously-compounded flat risk-free rate used when use_flat_discount_rate=true.

dividend_curve_id.description: Dividend yield curve id in pricing.curves used for implied-vol inversion.

use_flat_dividend_rate.description: If true and dividend_curve_id is empty, use flat_dividend_rate.

flat_dividend_rate.description: Continuously-compounded flat dividend yield used when use_flat_dividend_rate=true.

allow_extrapolation.description: Default extrapolation mode for this surface when consumed by pricing endpoints.

surface_interpolator.description:
Interpolation of a strike x expiry surface (see the enum): Bilinear
unless asked; `/calibrate-vol-surface` returns CubicStrikeLinearTime.

expiry_interpolator.description:
Deprecated for BlackVolSpec surfaces; retained for backward compatibility.
Mapping: (Linear,Linear)=>Bilinear, (LogCubic,LogCubic)=>Bicubic.

strike_interpolator.description:
Deprecated for BlackVolSpec surfaces; retained for backward compatibility.
Mapping: (Linear,Linear)=>Bilinear, (LogCubic,LogCubic)=>Bicubic.

quantra_YoYOptionletVolSpec.description:
Constant year-on-year inflation optionlet volatility, referenced by id from
year-on-year inflation cap/floor trades. Currently a single flat vol; a
strike/tenor surface form is a future additive extension (add optional
axis/matrix fields alongside `constant_vol`, mirroring OptionletVolSpec ->
AtmMatrix growth). The surface frequency and index-interpolation flag are
NOT carried here: they are taken at pricing time from the year-on-year
inflation index/curve the trade references, so the vol surface stays
convention-consistent with its index.

constant_vol.description:
Flat lognormal/normal optionlet volatility. Presence-required: an
omitted vol is a 400, never a silent 0.0.

vol_type.description:
Pricing formula / engine selector (Black / UnitDisplacedBlack /
Bachelier). Presence-required.

day_counter.description: Day counter for the vol surface time axis. Presence-required.

calendar.description:
Calendar the vol surface advances the reference date on.
Presence-required.

business_day_convention.description: Business-day convention for the vol surface. Presence-required.

observation_lag.description: Observation lag of the vol surface (e.g. 3 Months).

quantra_SviSlice.description:
One expiry of an `SviVolSpec`: the raw SVI total variance
w(k) = a + b (rho (k - m) + sqrt((k - m)^2 + sigma^2)), k = ln(K / forward)
(Gatheral's raw parameterisation, QuantLib `SviSmileSection`), the Black
vol being sqrt(w(k) / T) with T the base day counter's year fraction from
the reference date to `expiry`. The formula is global in strike: no
strike extrapolation exists or is needed.

expiry.description:
Expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD), strictly after the reference date; slices
must be strictly increasing.

forward.description: The forward the slice is written against (the origin of k), > 0.

b.description:
b >= 0; the slice must satisfy a + b sigma sqrt(1 - rho^2) >= 0 so the
minimum total variance is not negative.

quantra_SviVolSpec.description:
Black volatility as raw SVI slices (what `/calibrate-vol-surface` with
`SviPerExpiry` returns as `vol_surface_spec_svi`): the smile of every
quoted expiry with its exact curvature, so that a Dupire local vol
derived from it reprices the quotes through a Monte Carlo (the grid of
a `BlackVolSpec` loses that curvature between nodes unless it is
interpolated with `CubicStrikeLinearTime`). Accepted wherever a Black
vol is referenced (`price-equity-option` `volatility`, a structured
note's `underlyings[].volatility_id`); strike-dependent, so a structured
note simulates it as Dupire local vol with `monte_carlo.steps_per_year`.
`base` carries the reference date, calendar, business-day convention and
day counter only: `shape` must be left at its default, `constant_vol` and
`quote_id` absent (400 otherwise).

slices.description: At least one slice, strictly increasing expiries.

allow_extrapolation.description:
Whether an expiry beyond the last slice may be read at all (flat
implied vol); strikes need no flag, the formula is global.

quantra_VolSurfaceSpec.description: Volatility surface specification referenced by id in trade requests.

quantra_CorrelationMatrixSpec.description:
Correlation matrix between the underlyings of a basket product, referenced
by id from the trade (`StructuredNote.correlation_id`). There is no
correlation market: the matrix is an input (historical estimate, dealer
mark) and the engine only validates it. It must be square, symmetric,
with a unit diagonal and every entry in [-1, 1], and positive
semi-definite (a Cholesky factorisation must succeed); otherwise the
request is a 400 naming the first offending pair of labels, or "not
positive semi-definite". No repair is applied to the matrix as supplied;
a bump-and-reprice correlation sensitivity may repair the BUMPED matrix
and says so in the response.

id.description:
Identifier referenced by trades (e.g. "QUAD_INDEX_HIST_2Y"). Required;
unique within pricing.correlations.matrices.

labels.description:
Ids of the underlyings the rows/columns refer to, in matrix order:
`EquityUnderlyingSpec.id` (or `FxSpotSpec.id` for products that
simulate an FX rate). Required; at least two distinct entries. A
trade referencing this matrix must have exactly these underlyings
(any order; the engine permutes), 400 naming the missing or extra
label otherwise.

values.description:
The matrix: n_rows = n_cols = len(labels), values row-major in label
order, inline or via quote_ids into pricing.quotes. Required.

quantra_CorrelationMarketData.description: Correlation market data grouped under the shared Pricing context.

matrices.description: Correlation matrices referenced by id from basket products.

quantra_Fixing.description: Historical index fixing for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexDef.description: Complete index definition. Registered once per request, referenced by id.

index_type.description:
IBOR or Overnight. Determines QuantLib class used. Presence-required: an
omitted value is a 400, never the silent Ibor default.

tenor.description: Tenor period (e.g., 6 Months for Euribor 6M, 0 Days for overnight).

fixing_days.description: Fixing days (e.g., 2 for Euribor, 0 for SOFR/ESTR). Presence-required.

end_of_month.description:
End of month rule (IBOR only, ignored for overnight). Presence-required:
absent-vs-false silently changes money-market schedule dates.

fixings.description: Past fixings needed for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexRef.description: Reference to an IndexDef by its id.

quantra_PriceSeries.description:
One underlying's price history: closes on strictly increasing dates,
every value > 0. The engine never fetches prices; it receives them.

underlying_id.description:
`EquityUnderlyingSpec.id` the series stands for; becomes a label of
the returned correlation matrix. Required, unique within `series`.

closes.description:
`{date, value}` closes in strictly increasing date order (400
otherwise), value > 0. Required, at least one entry.

quantra_CorrelationEstimator.description:
Settings of the historical correlation estimator. Every field has a
default; the response echoes the settings as resolved (an explicit
window instead of `window_days`) so the result can be reproduced from
the echo alone.

window_days.description:
Calendar days back from `as_of_date`: the window is
[as_of_date - window_days, as_of_date]. Absent and no explicit
window: every date common to all series is used, closes after
`as_of_date` included. Must be > 0; 400 together with `start_date`
or `end_date`.

start_date.description:
Explicit window, inclusive, ISO dates; either bound may be absent
(no bound on that side). 400 with `window_days`, or when
`start_date` is after `end_date`.

frequency.description:
Daily (default, every common date) or Weekly (every fifth common
observation counted back from the last).

shrinkage_intensity.description:
Intensity in [0, 1] toward the constant-correlation target. Required
iff `shrinkage` is Fixed (400 otherwise).

min_overlap.description:
Least number of dates common to all series inside the window (before
the frequency sampling); 400 below it. Must be >= 3.

eigenvalue_floor.description:
Eigenvalue the negative ones are raised to when the estimated (and
shrunk) matrix is not positive semi-definite to the registry's
tolerance (smallest eigenvalue below -1e-10; a rank-deficient matrix
such as a perfectly correlated pair, eigenvalue 0, is returned as
is): eigenvalues clipped to the floor, the matrix rescaled to unit
diagonal, the response says so. Finite, in [0, 1).

quantra_CalibrateCorrelationRequest.description:
Request for `/calibrate-correlation`: a correlation matrix, ready to
paste under `pricing.correlations.matrices`, from the price histories
of two or more underlyings. Returns on the dates common to every series
inside the window, sample correlation, optional shrinkage toward the
constant-correlation target, positive semi-definiteness enforced by an
eigenvalue floor. There is no `pricing` block: the endpoint reads no
market data other than the closes given here.

as_of_date.description:
Anchor of `window_days` and the date the estimate is labelled with.
Required. Closes after it are not an error (they are used unless a
window excludes them).

series.description: At least two series with distinct `underlying_id`s. Required.

estimator.description: Estimator settings; the defaults apply when absent.

correlation_id.description: Id given to the returned `CorrelationMatrixSpec`. Required.

labels.description:
Row/column order of the returned matrix: a permutation of the
`underlying_id`s of `series` (400 otherwise). Absent = series order.

quantra_CorrelationSeriesReport.description:
Per-series report of `/calibrate-correlation`, in the output label
order.

dropped.description:
Closes not used: outside the window, on a date some other series
lacks, or skipped by the Weekly sampling. `observations - dropped`
is `observations_used` for every series.

annualised_volatility.description:
Realised volatility of the returns used, annualised on an Act/252
basis: sqrt(unbiased variance x 252 / step) with step 1 (Daily) or 5
(Weekly). A by-product; not what pricing should use for a vol.

correlation_spec.description:
The estimated matrix under the request's `correlation_id`, labels in
the output order, values row-major: ready to paste under
`pricing.correlations.matrices` and reference from a trade.

sample_correlation.description:
The sample correlation before shrinkage and before the eigenvalue
floor, row-major in the same label order.

shrinkage_target.description:
The constant-correlation target: the average of the off-diagonal
sample correlations.

shrinkage_intensity_used.description:
Intensity applied: 0 for None, the Ledoit-Wolf value (clipped to
[0, 1]) for LedoitWolf, the request's value for Fixed. Off-diagonal
entries of the result are `intensity x target + (1 - intensity) x
sample` before the eigenvalue floor. With exactly two series the
target equals the sample correlation and the intensity is reported
as 0 (there is nothing to shrink).

eigenvalue_floor_applied.description:
True when the shrunk matrix was not positive semi-definite to the
registry's tolerance (smallest eigenvalue below -1e-10) and was
repaired (eigenvalues clipped to `eigenvalue_floor`, rescaled to
unit diagonal).

smallest_eigenvalue_before.description: Smallest eigenvalue of the shrunk matrix before the floor.

smallest_eigenvalue_after.description:
Smallest eigenvalue of the returned matrix (equal to `before` when
the floor was not applied).

observations_used.description:
Price observations that entered the returns (after the window, the
alignment and the frequency sampling); the same for every series.

first_date.description: First and last observation dates used.

series.description: One entry per series, in the output label order.

estimator_echo.description:
The estimator settings as resolved: the explicit window actually
applied (`start_date` / `end_date`, never `window_days`), the
returns, frequency and shrinkage used, `shrinkage_intensity` present
iff the shrinkage is Fixed, `min_overlap` and `eigenvalue_floor`.
Posting the same series with this block as `estimator` reproduces
the response.
